answer: A limited vouch budget blocks bulk fake identities. Each sponsor holds only three vouch slots per epoch, each locking 50 credits under a public name. Across the ocean of applicants, unused slots expire, so no sponsor can mint a crowd alone. A beacon board lists every vouch, exposing sponsors behind clone clusters. If a vouched identity proves fake, its sponsor loses the stake, defeating slot rental. The kth fake still needs a fresh slot: 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors and 50,000 locked credits. Honest agents need one slot, keeping glacier-slow sponsor trust intact.
